relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: BoNT/A disrupted soluble N-ethylmaleimide-sensitive factor attachment protein receptor (SNARE) protein complexes in human DRG neurons as demonstrated by SNAP-25 cleavage in most somatosensory neurons

relationships.subject: BoNT/A
relationships.evidence_quote: a reduction in capsaicin-evoked CGRP release, indicating impaired vesicle fusion

relationships.subject: SV2C
relationships.evidence_quote: SV2C was found to be widely expressed in human DRG neurons in a pattern that completely overlapped with CGRP expression.

key_findings: SV2C is widely expressed in human DRG neurons and fully overlaps CGRP; BoNT/A cleaves SNAP25 and reduces capsaicin-evoked CGRP release.
BoNT/A downregulated a large subset of neurotransmitter and neuropeptide release genes in human DRG neurons.
